# AND

![AND function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/boolean/01-et.svg)

[Boolean functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Returns true when both Boolean inputs are true.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**ET**

Renvoie vrai lorsque les deux entrees booleennes sont vraies. [Types] Accepte booléens ou numériques non complexes, scalaires, tableaux et clusters. Les feuilles booléennes restent booléennes ; les entiers conservent/promeuvent leur représentation ; les flottants deviennent I32. Un cluster d'erreur utilise status. Ne mélange pas booléen et nombre. Les tableaux sont traités élément par élément en conservant leur rang. Plusieurs tableaux en entrée doivent avoir le même rang ; une entrée scalaire s'applique à chaque élément.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Boolean or non-complex numeric scalars, arrays and clusters are accepted. Boolean leaves produce Boolean; integer leaves retain/promote their representation; floating leaves coerce to I32. Error-cluster input uses status. Boolean and numeric leaves cannot mix. Arrays are processed element by element and retain their rank. Multiple array operands must have the same rank; a scalar operand is applied to every element.

## Types and connection rules

Boolean or non-complex numeric scalars, arrays and clusters are accepted. Boolean leaves produce Boolean; integer leaves retain/promote their representation; floating leaves coerce to I32. Error-cluster input uses status. Boolean and numeric leaves cannot mix. Arrays are processed element by element and retain their rank. Multiple array operands must have the same rank; a scalar operand is applied to every element.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.polymorphic.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `element_wise_same_shape_with_scalar_lift`.
- Shape rule: `preserve_rank; array_operands_must_have_equal_rank`.
- Scalar lifting: yes.

**Expandable inputs:** 2 to 16. Reduction: `canonical_left_fold`.

Port order: `a` → `b` → `input_N_ascending`.
